summary: One-line production fix is minimal and targeted. One finding raised about a newly reachable prev_row=None code path requires verification before approval.

findings.title: allow_zero=True now reachable with prev_row=None in _compute_spend_delta_safe
findings.description: When existing is None and prev_day_map has no entry for the category, prev_row is None. With the fix, allow_zero=True is passed alongside prev_row=None — a combination previously unreachable because the zero-delta skip would have short-circuited first. If _compute_spend_delta dereferences prev_row without a None guard, this raises AttributeError on the first widget load for a new user with zero prior spend.
findings.suggestion: Verify that _compute_spend_delta handles prev_row=None safely before merging.
